svg.title: F15-2 Fuel system of one generator: bulk tank, duplex transfer, filter and day tank with level control
svg.text: overflow and return line to the bulk tank
standby pump P-02 in parallel (not drawn)
close inlet SV-01, stop pump, alarm
F15-2 Fuel system of one generator: bulk tank, duplex transfer, filter and day tank with level control
bulk tank to day tank 1,500 L · duty and standby transfer pumps 3,000 L/h · engine 720 L/h at full load · day tank levels 95 / 90 / 60 / 40 / 15 % · overflow return to bulk
• Net fill rate with the engine at full load is 3,000 - 720 = 2,280 L/h, so 60 % to 90 % (450 L) takes 11.8 minutes.
• Low-low at 15 % (225 L) leaves about 19 minutes at 720 L/h (18.75); each set point is proven by lifting the float and watching the pump and the BMS alarm.
